text: Isai.21.8. , Heb. fenced place. , Or, in me. , Or, when I am argued with. Heb. vpon my reproofe or arguing.
Ier.22.13. , Or, gaineth an euill gaine. , Heb. palme of the hand.
Or, piece, or, fastening. , Or, witnesse against it.
Or, by knowing the glory of the Lord. , Isai.11.9.
Or, more with shame then with glory. , Ier.25.26.
Ier.10.8, 14. zec.10. 2. , Heb. The facioner of his facion.
Psal.11.4. , Heb. be silent all the earth before him.
